meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, cleans up CLAUDE.local.md files, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2 并需要自动化收尾
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2 and need automated cleanup

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会引导你完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾工作：设置所有者、清理旧配置文件、调整容器设置，并帮你移植自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”、“v1 migration”等关键词，且已运行过 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 脚本后触发。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾。
say.note: Claude 会检查迁移脚本是否已运行，然后开始引导。

say.text: 设置我为机器人所有者。
清理各组中的 CLAUDE.local.md 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through finishing the migration from NanoClaw v1 to v2: seeding the owner, cleaning up old config files, reconciling container settings, and helping port custom code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration", and after you have run `bash migrate-v2.sh`.

say_en.text: Help me finish the v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: Claude checks if the migration script ran, then starts guiding.

say_en.text: Set me as the bot owner.
Clean up CLAUDE.local.md files in groups.
